text:
Maya: FYI noticed a token-level latency spike on /chat and /summarize after yesterday's kernel-selector tweak. p95 up ~30ms.
Sam: saw the alert at 01:12 UTC, digging into logs + traces now. link: https://grafana.redwood/alerts/1745
Maya: quick paste from profiler: 
```
perf_summary: {
  token_lat_p50: +18ms,
  token_lat_p95: +32ms,
}
kv_cache_hit_rate_total{route="/chat"}: 0.60 -> 0.35
prefix_cache_evictions_total{route="/summarize"}: +1.2k
memory: prefix_cache_bytes_total{route="/chat"}: 7.8GB -> 9.5GB
```
Izzy: hmm looks like the kernel selector started preferring a fallback kernel (cuFFT->generic) for certain seq-lens which inflates kernel_exec time. We should split token latency into: schedule_wait + kv_lookup + kv_apply_prefix + kernel_exec + post_proc.
Jordan: agree. Batching heuristics might be compounding it: larger dynamic batches increase schedule_wait. We need per-route batch_size_hist and schedule_wait_ms.
Maya: proposed new metrics to add: 
- runtime_token_latency_components_ms (labels: route, model, stage) -> histogram
- kv_prefix_hit_rate{route, model} gauge (or derived from counters)
- kv_prefix_evictions_total{route} counter
- kv_prefix_mem_bytes{route, shard} gauge
- prefix_reuse_ratio{route} gauge (reused_prefix_tokens / total_prefix_tokens)
- batch_schedule_wait_ms{route, model} histogram
Sam: love it. For dashboards: add a "Token latency waterfall" panel that stacks the components so we can see kernel_exec vs KV time per token. Also a per-route table with hit_rate, evictions/1h, mem_bytes, reuse_ratio.
Izzy: sample PromQL for hit rate we can instrument quickly: 
```
sum(rate(kv_prefix_hits_total[5m])) by (route) / sum(rate(kv_prefix_lookups_total[5m])) by (route)
```
And evictions: 
```
sum(rate(kv_prefix_evictions_total[1h])) by (route)
```
Jordan: perf-bot shows a regression spike correlated with kernel selection change: 
perf-bot: regression-detect: kernel_choice=generic_fallback increased by 15% on /chat between 01:00-02:00 UTC.
Sam: I'm seeing LRU eviction not triggering correctly on one of the prefix shards, looks like an off-by-one in the eviction loop. Could explain mem_bytes creep.
Maya: action items: 
- @Izzy add the runtime_token_latency_components_ms histogram and batch_schedule_wait_ms to the runtime exporter (priority P0).
- @Sam open a PR to revert the kernel selector rule temporarily and add a canary test to ensure kernel_exec time doesn't regress.
- @Jordan add the per-route prefix cache panels to the "Serving Runtime Perf" Grafana board and a shortlink in the playbook.
- @perf-bot add an alert: kv_prefix_hit_rate{route=~"/.+"} < 0.5 for 15m -> SEV2.
Izzy: noted, will draft PR for metrics + PromQL panels today.
Sam: starting the rollback PR now, will run perf-suite.
Maya: thanks — let's sync in 30m if anyone finds a smoking gun. :mag: :chart_with_upwards_trend:
